name: collaborative-chess
description: A collaborative chess game that runs on Cloudflare Workers using Durable Objects with GitHub Primer styling

scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run dev:watch & bunx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.build: bunx tsc && cp dist/client.js public/ && cp dist/client.d.ts public/ && cp dist/getPossibleMoves.js public/ && cp dist/getPossibleMoves.d.ts public/ && cp dist/types.js public/
